object.name: evi_4wave
object.digest: Simultaneous antialiased Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine oscillators
object.description: Phase synchronous shared frequency oscillators with simultaneous Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine outputs. Antialiasing method is 4-point polyblep.

inlets.name: reset
inlets.digest: Reset is naive and not antialiased.

outlets.name: saw
outlets.digest: Antialiased Saw oscillator in sync with other outputs

outlets.name: rect
outlets.digest: Antialiased Rect oscillator in sync with other outputs

outlets.name: tri
outlets.digest: Antialiased Tri oscillator in sync with other outputs

outlets.name: sine
outlets.digest: Antialiased Sine oscillator in sync with other outputs, the sine is not pure and has an additional harmonic.

outlets.name: phase
outlets.digest: Phase of oscillators for synchronising processes downstream.

attributes.name: zerosync
attributes.description: If on, tri phase is aligned at zero crossings with the other three oscillators. If off (slightly cheaper) tri phase is at the peak of the tri shape.
